acceptance_criteria.requirement: Settings uses one header, an unambiguous 152 px active rail, active-page scroller, optional shared PreviewDock, and final-row footer at every width.

The window defaults to 1200x800, enforces 1040x700 when the screen permits, keeps its complete decorated frame and footer inside available geometry, centers a maximum-1240 inner shell, and uses the same dock in the small-screen overlay fallback. Its parented WindowModal open lifecycle assigns no coordinates, renders as an attached macOS sheet in Anki's full-screen Space, and creates Preview only after the sheet is visible.

Section and Full dashboard render through the production renderer; Fit scales top-aligned without clipping in a content-aware compact canvas with no dead full-height panel, and 100 percent owns the preview secondary scrollbar.
All four pages are captured at 1040, 1200, and full-screen widths at 100 and 150 percent application fonts.
Revert, Close, Save changes, and the inline save-error region remain reachable in stable final-row positions.
Events proves empty, populated, selected, searched, and archived states with legible two-line rows, one context-appropriate Add event CTA, and selected-event calendar preview.
Bible proves short, long, and custom verses with reference/excerpt rows, Current and Preview badges, separate selection and rotation, and incremental loading.
About proves matched-height side-by-side Version and Help cards, compact privacy/legal disclosures, byte-exact Scripture attribution, and complete Backup and recovery content.

Dirty, revert, successful save, inline failure, cleanly aligned legacy Calendar routing without a clipped preceding card, fixed/clamped window geometry, and controlled restart are proven without persisting Preview visibility.
Font-relative targets grow naturally at 150 percent without an alternate layout tree or clipped text.
The transparent root remains in normal flow at max 1120 px with 24 px top and 20 px side minimums and no root viewport-height or overflow clipping.

A visible fixed or sticky bottom-action container is detected without localized button text and drives root padding and document scroll padding by measured height plus 24 px; 60 px is fallback height only.
Month and Year reuse one 24 px title and compact 34 px control header that wraps naturally without hiding controls.
Month always renders a 42-cell six-week grid and retains independently visible completion, selection, today, due, and event cues.

Year keeps one real 53-week tree with fluid week columns, compacts its 28 px label column and 3 px gaps below 760 px, has no horizontal scrolling at 480 px and above, and confines any sub-480 px overflow to the heatmap.
Legend and date/event summary are compact and conditional while browsing, editing, adding, tooltips, date selection, and Most Missed remain intact.
Every theme-specific saved palette ID has separately authored and visually distinct light and dark completion ladders while IDs and selections stay unchanged.
White, black, purple, and image hosts preserve Anki chrome and remain legible without repainting the host.
Production and 100 percent preview render the configured verse font, size, and color exactly; Fit scales that same component.
Schema remains 8 and name sorting is case-insensitive by name, then date and stable ID; ascending and descending retain date semantics.

Today's Progress is collection-wide minus dashboard deck exclusions, sums independently limited top-level due-tree heads, classifies queues 0 as New, 1/3/4 as Learning, and 2 as Review regardless of card type, excludes queues -1/-2/-3, remains independent of the selected deck, and enforces Total remaining = New + Learning + Reviews.

Today's Session uses exactly [next rollover - 86400 seconds, next rollover), counts distinct qualifying introductions, counts only explicitly buried cards that are New or currently due/overdue, calculates seconds per answer, and retains the whole-minute-ceiling ETA policy.
Last 7 Days and All Time match Anki 26.8.1 true-retention eligibility, display one half-up whole percentage, and display Again as its exact visible complement.

Calendar history and selected-day details use the same rollover-relative records, while due forecasting matches Anki's non-new, non-suspended future-due logic including original filtered-deck due dates and future buried cards but excluding buried work due today.
Initial HTML, live refresh, wide Month and Year 2x2 layouts, intermediate and narrow layouts, Settings Preview, and restart all expose identical metric values from one canonical snapshot.
Config and manual verse writes are prepared before mutation, previous config and bytes are retained, and a partial failure attempts rollback before a specific inline error.
The reproducible 1.8.6 archive passes its allowlist, safe-path, byte-parity, manifest/assets, secret/link, and exact-installed-hash gates.
Fresh and restarted Anki 26.8 runs prove process, window, filesystem, and sync isolation before interaction.
VoiceOver, Windows, Linux, forced colors, DPR 1, and OS display scaling remain explicitly unrun unless separately executed.
